description: Source code for Tensor creation and memory management functions in the ATen library, part of PyTorch, including tensor construction, storage size calculation, and data pointer creation.

classes.name: TensorMaker
classes.description: Class responsible for creating tensors with specific memory layouts and properties.

methods.name: make_tensor
methods.description: Creates a tensor with specified storage, shape, strides, and other properties.

methods.name: computeStorageSize
methods.description: Calculates the total storage size in bytes needed for the tensor.

methods.name: makeDataPtrFromDeleter
methods.description: Creates a DataPtr using a custom deleter.

methods.name: makeDataPtrFromContext
methods.description: Creates a DataPtr from existing context and data.

methods.name: makeTempSizes
methods.description: Generates temporary size array based on memory format.
